verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own site says it can convert any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, which directly names JSON as an output format for fetched web content. The support rests on one marketing line with no detailed docs. missing for 10: documentation of the JSON structure or schema, schema-driven structured extraction details, API/SDK reference for the JSON output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
